title: Web3 Friends Like You
tagline: Get matched with web3 friends like you and chat with them. Meet new friends anonymously.
description: Web3 Friends Like You matches you with a wallet address that has similar qualities as your wallet address (ex. similar tokens, memberships, etc.) and enables an exclusive chat with the matched wallet address. Web3 Friends Like You uses open-source data on wallet activity to identify interesting people in web3 you should talk to without comprising your or their identities.
how_its_made: The project initially identifies Lens Protocol users by wallet address. It uses queries on Dune Analytics to get data on similar addresses and the Dune Analytics API to return the data to get processed in a random wallet address return generator. It then opens a chat with XMTP with the wallet address.
